limitations: No rustfmt, rustc, Cargo, test or native execution.
Orchestrator must create exactly one scope immediately before its group of child starts and pass the same reference to all children; integration is still pending.
Wall time of arbitrary external caller work between operations is not bounded by this helper; existing parent test/protocol deadline remains controlling.
As in c269, kernel process spawn and synchronous /proc credential observations are unchanged; the shared timer bounds polling/wait loops and is checked around startup.
Distinct UIDs are a necessary public-channel condition, not a successful handshake or typed trust proof.
Current same-host Version/Source/S/C live socket edges are unresolved; this harness does not make them admissible.
scope_changes: Explicit three fixed non-Root UIDs and role labels.
One explicit shared scope passed to every child start.
Startup ready wait uses the shared initial deadline.
First finish establishes one common join deadline; all finish calls reuse it.
First failed cleanup or Drop establishes one common kill/reap deadline; all child cleanup uses it.
The scope rejects child start once join/cleanup has begun.
unchanged: Original credential drop, exact executable FD/FQN, env_clear, and fixed 8 MiB stack.
Original process identity/pidfd and actual SO_PEERCRED comparisons.
No transferred Client/authority/Arc, no synthesized role response or receipt.
Per-control operation 5-second observation bounds and 64 KiB datagram limit.
1 MiB per-stream retained output prefix and real normal-zero/EOF requirement.
Original same-UID/PID production refusals, per-host connection/request limits and protocol deadlines.
